title: How to define swing
summary: Swing cannot be defined; Fats Waller and Ralph Sutton remarks.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Okay. Well put. Well this is a great room to be in. And we’re coming up on our two hour mark here. So this has been a real fascinating conversation.
Any final questions that you want to ask me?
Yeah. How do you define swing?
Didn’t Fats Waller or somebody say if you have to ask that question you’ll never know or something like that.
Ralph Sutton told me that Fats Waller said, “get that right ticking rhythm and it’s happening” or something like that. I actually like the fact that certain things can’t be defined.
